pages.text: Nine schools, each with a distinct identity and playstyle. Gear with school affinity directly boosts power for that school — specialize early for best results.$(br2)$(bold)Fire$() — Direct damage and AoE ignition. Aggressive, close-range, unsubtle.$(br2)$(bold)Ice$() — Slows, roots, and freezes. Strong for kiting or controlling boss movement.$(br2)$(bold)Lightning$() — Fast projectiles with chain arcs. Burst-heavy, punishes clustered enemies.

$(bold)Holy$() — Healing and enhanced damage against undead. Near-essential for sustained solo bossing.$(br2)$(bold)Blood$() — Life drain and debuffs. Sustain-through-combat school.$(br2)$(bold)Evocation$() — Summons creatures and constructs. Field a small army and fight from behind it.

$(bold)Nature$() — Roots, poison, movement enhancement. Utility and control.$(br2)$(bold)Eldritch$() — Chaotic, high-damage spells from beyond normal arcane theory. Expensive mana cost, punishing output.$(br2)$(bold)Ender$() — Teleportation, phase blink, dimensional effects. Pure mobility.$(br2)School-affinity gear stacks. A full affinity set at a given school meaningfully outperforms mixed gear.
